Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

travel — to go from one place to another. Example: Last summer I travelled to Spain.
holiday — a day or period of celebration or rest. Example: The holiday is in spring.
hotel — a building where travellers sleep. Example: We stayed in a hotel.
beach — the sand next to the sea. Example: The hotel is near the beach.
city — a large town. Example: We visited a big city.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Last summer I travelled to ...
• We stayed in a hotel.
• It was hot.
• The food was delicious.
• We visited ...
